title: Mail: EmailSubmission identical values + MDN test
description: Template: jmap_server::check_read_only_patch / strip_read_only_patch (crate-jmap-server/src/helpers.rs) as used in mail (8a4d5b74 rewritten; git log --grep 'bd: JMAP-t8ej.25.1'). RFC 8620 §5.3: server-set properties MAY be in the patch if identical to the current value, else invalidProperties. Mark's decisions (on JMAP-t8ej.27 notes): {} and identical-only patches are a no-op success (updated {id:null}, no write, state unchanged); unknown-only patches and empty structural arrays stay errors. ORDER (lesson from t8ej.26): existence -> permission/closed-state/forbidden gates -> read-only check -> no-op exit. One test per handler, oracle the RFC/spec text. jmap-mail-server submission.rs process_update (~1052) accepts only undoStatus; accept identical id/emailId/identityId/other server-set or immutable props (RFC 8621 §7: emailId, identityId immutable). Mark's DECISION: change tests/integration.rs::submission_set_update_only_undo_status_allowed (~4602) to send a DIFFERENT emailId (still expects invalidProperties); list in tests_changed. Also: decide whether MDN/send empty onSuccessUpdateEmail patch is reachable (mdn.rs ~536-549); if reachable add mdn_on_success_empty_patch_is_noop, if not, say why with file:line.
